# bolt.new Reviews

### The community submitted 47 reviews to tell us what they like about bolt.new, what bolt.new can do better, and more.

Based on 47 reviews

Review bolt.new?

Reviewers mostly see bolt.new as a fast, practical way to turn prompts into real browser-run prototypes, mockups, landing pages, and simple SaaS apps without local setup. Users repeatedly praise the in-browser workflow, editable code, and quick path from idea to demo, while founders of Composio, Magic Hour, and Rankfender echo its speed and full-stack scaffolding. The main complaints are token costs and poor transparency, occasional error loops or over-aggressive rewrites, weaker reliability on larger projects, and frustrating support or account issues for some paid users.

Summarized with AI

Pros

Cons [...] #### What's great

fast prototyping (7)mvp creation (2)

I'm a developer and I try a lot of tools — bolt.new is one of the few that genuinely works out of the box. I used it to build several working mockups: not slides or static screens, but real, clickable apps I could hand to someone. Going from a prompt to something that actually runs, in the browser, with zero local setup, is the part that impressed me.

#### What needs improvement

AI limitations (5)

One real limitation I hit: on certain errors it gets stuck in a loop — it keeps trying to fix them and never quite gets there. When that happened, rewriting the prompt from scratch was faster than letting it iterate. To be fair, this was a while ago and it may well be fixed by now.

Ratings

Ease of use

Reliability

Value for money [...] Bolt.new by StackBlitz is honestly one of the most impressive tools I’ve come across for web development. It combines manual coding with AI-powered features so seamlessly. You can give it plain text prompts, and it generates a solid codebase for your app—front-end, back-end, and even databases like Supabase. Plus, it runs everything in your browser with no setup hassles. The fact that you can use frameworks like React, Vue, Svelte, or even Astro is a huge win. It also lets you install NPM packages, configure backends, and deploy your project instantly to Netlify. This makes prototyping or creating an MVP super quick and efficient. What I loved the most is the error detection AI—it’s not just about generating code; it actively fixes issues and gives suggestions. Deployment is a breeze
